*`Congratulations, you are a candidate for joining the Instalily team!`* `Background:` 

`This case study focuses on developing an AI-powered business-to-business (B2B) sales intelligence platform specifically targeted at generating leads for the sales team at a roofing distributor. The platform will leverage public data sources, particularly GAF, to pre-generate actionable sales insights and recommendations for this sales team to review during account planning. The goal is to create a comprehensive solution that helps sales teams identify, understand, and effectively engage with decision-makers.` 

**`Data Source`**`:` 

`https://www.gaf.com/en-us/roofing-contractors/residential?distance=25 Use ZIPCODE: 10013` 

**`Objectives`**`:` 

`1. Intuitive UI` 

○ `There must be a way for reps to view the leads the system generates.` 

○ `Bonus points if the interface is visually polished, presents information in a clear and intuitive way, or includes` 

`distinctive or creative features.` 

`2. Robust data management` 

○ `Your solution will likely need a way to store, organize, and retrieve data. We are looking for approaches that would be suitable for a production environment.` 

○ `Due to time constraints, it is acceptable to outline future improvements or describe how your approach could evolve in a full production system.` 

`3. Scalable pipeline` 

○ `Whatever pipeline you implement should be designed with scale in mind, as it may eventually support hundreds or thousands of sales representatives. Consider how your approach could remain reliable as usage grows.` 

○ `Clear, well-structured code and sound engineering practices are important for maintainability, collaboration, and minimizing long-term technical debt.` 

**`Time:`** 

`Until 4 pm, or as designated by on-site lead`
